spans.s: 1. tvá, prn. st. of second pers. (v. tvad).
2. tvá, poss. prn. thy.

tvak-tra, n. armour;
 -trāṇa, n. protection 🞄of the skin.
TVAKṢ, Ⅱ. only with pra, pr. pt. 🞄-tvakṣ-āṇa, pre-eminent.
tvákṣ-as, n. energy, activity.
tvak-sāra, m. reed, cane (lit. in 🞄which the rind is the chief thing): -vyavahāra-vat, a. whose occupation is in reeds, 🞄dealing in cane.
tvaṃ-kāra, m. addressing as ‘thou.’
tvaṅ-māṃsa‿asthi-maya, 🞄a. consisting of skin, flesh, and bones.

tvác, f. skin, hide;
 bark, rind.

tvac-a, n. id. (esp. —˚ a.);
 -ana, n. 🞄skinning.
tvát, त्वद् tvád, ab. and base (—˚) of 🞄tvam, thou.
tvád, v. त्वत् tvát.
tvad-īya, a. thy, thine.
tvad-vidha, a. like thee.
tvan-maya, a. consisting in thee, containing 🞄thee only.
tu‿ám, nm. sg. thou: tvaṃ kṛ, call (ac.) 🞄‘thou.’

tvar-ita, pp.;
 n. haste, hurry.
tvaṣ-ṭi, f. carpentry.

tváṣ-ṭṛ, m. wright, carpenter;
 N. of 🞄a Vedic god, the divine artificer: -devatya, 🞄a. having Tvaṣṭṛ as its deity.

tvā-dṛś, a. (nm. m. f. n. k) resembling 🞄thee;
 -dṛśa, a. (ī): -ka, a. id..
tvāyā́, in. ad. for love of thee.
tvā́-vat, a. like thee.

tvāṣṭrá, a. belonging to Tvaṣṭṛ;
 🞄Tvaṣṭṛʼs son.
